### 0.2.9 Change Log
#### Global
##### Added
###### Badges, Trophies & Collections
* Added a Badge Editor for custom badge and trophy sets, names, counts, and textures.
* Added sample badges and trophies with DRM Asset Loader texture selection.
* Added separate badge front and back textures, using the front image when no back is set.
* Added formatted badge descriptions with wrapping and scrolling.
* Added persistent player collections, badge conditions, trainer rewards, and badge quest objectives.
* Added player badge and trophy ownership management in DRM Admin.
* Added operator badge and trophy give/take commands with name completion.
* Added queued badge and trophy changes for offline players in DRM Admin.
* Added searchable DRM dialogue targets for badge and trophy grants and removals.
* Added a victory badge reward to default trainers for easy testing.
###### Badge Presentations & GUI Maker
* Added centered text controls for badge names and descriptions in GUI Maker.
* Added three simple badge presets: Soft Shine, Golden Ring, and Gentle Rise.
* Added default acquisition and inspection presentations for badges and trophies.
* Added drag ordering and resizable panels to badge and presentation editors.
* Added independent acquisition and inspection presentations with per-set defaults.
* Added shared presentation presets, keyframe editing, previews, and copy editing.
* Added badge rotation, metallic glints, outlines, particles, and pixel assembly effects.
* Added GUI Maker layouts for badge collections, details, and acquisition notices.
* Added queued acquisition overlays, optional confirmation popups, reduced motion, and sound controls.
###### RCT Trainer Conversion
* Added RCT trainer conversion to DNPC with RCT or DRM AI selection.
* Added original RCT AI, bag, and battle-rule preservation as the default.
* Added nearby RCT NPC replacement with backups of the original entities.
###### Post-Battle Actions
* Added an After Actions option to return players to their last completed healing location.
* Added Sequential mode for post-battle actions.
* Added ordered action execution, allowing rewards to be given after dialogue ends.
* Added support for resuming remaining actions after reconnecting or restarting the server.
* Added a limit of one dialogue action per round.
###### Pokémon Settings & Appearance
* Added native Cobblemon Alpha settings for NPC appearances, trainers, Pokémon Itself, and Pokémon slots.
* Added Alpha size, matching hitboxes, glowing red eyes, bloom, and eye trails.
* Added live IV/EV previews with stat changes, HP parity, and random-value ranges.
* Added draggable panel resizing to the Pokémon inspector.
* Added model-based appearance choices, including Torterra's tree variants.
###### PokeMart
* Added DRM's shared currency search picker to PokeMart currency fields.
##### Fixed
###### Badges & Collections
* Fixed stale collection ownership after returning from badge details.
* Fixed removed badges remaining in open collections and queued acquisition notices.
* Fixed disabled badge definitions preventing ownership removal.
* Fixed missing-texture question marks appearing beside badge set names.
* Fixed transparent badge pixels appearing black in previews and collection displays.
* Fixed badge thumbnails disappearing behind collection card backgrounds.
###### Badge Presentations & Acquisition
* Fixed battle presentation imports changing the badge presentation canvas size.
* Fixed acquisition badges, titles, and descriptions remaining outside the screen center.
* Fixed installed acquisition defaults failing to update with existing Core skin settings.
* Fixed acquisition GUI Maker and runtime using different canvas dimensions.
* Fixed badge image sizes changing when acquisition presentations finished.
* Fixed acquisition sounds being cut off when visual timelines finished.
* Fixed crashes when importing battle presentations into the badge editor.
* Fixed misleading previews when badge events have no assigned presentation.
* Fixed named badge sources remaining blank in acquisition screens on fresh clients.
###### Badge & Presentation Editors
* Fixed duplicate overlapping hover labels on badge and presentation editor toolbars.
* Fixed Badge Editor Load failing to open searchable set selection after reloading.
* Fixed excessive spacing between related badge and presentation editor actions.
* Fixed long badge texture paths being truncated when opening editor fields.
* Fixed invalid presentation Save As attempts changing the original document identity.
* Fixed background fields receiving input during dropdowns, confirmations, and pending saves.
* Fixed effect properties applying invalid textures and retaining stale sound-picker values.
* Fixed badge actions ignoring GUI Maker vanilla-button settings and disabled states.
###### RCT Trainer Conversion
* Fixed preserved RCT battles being blocked by their own NPC intro reservations.
* Fixed RCT party edits overwriting unrelated original Pokémon settings.
* Fixed RCT party reordering mixing Pokémon nicknames, gimmicks, and held-item alternatives.
* Fixed large RCT profiles losing data when saved to NPCs.
* Fixed converted DNPC names resetting after reloading.
* Fixed DRM conversion ignoring available fallback held items.
###### NPC Behavior & Profiles
* Fixed missing trainer cooldowns after battle completion, including losses and fleeing.
* Fixed trainer previews losing appearance data from registered NPC actors.
* Fixed server JSON profiles failing to apply to Starter Selector and PokeMart NPCs.
* Fixed pre-battle repositioning conflicting with DNPC position locking.
* Fixed dash speed remaining active when trainer return movement was interrupted.
###### Post-Battle Actions
* Fixed scheduler NPCs disappearing before post-battle actions and dialogues finished.
* Fixed failed command and advancement actions being marked as successfully completed.
* Fixed full action queues silently losing newly earned or previously saved rewards.
###### Pokémon Settings & Battle AI
* Fixed unnecessary Dragon Cheer on allies with guaranteed Leek critical hits.
* Fixed battle AI rejecting useful status Z-Moves.
* Fixed Simple Beam overvaluing allies whose only setup move is Belly Drum.
* Fixed hidden IV/EV fields in Random and Default modes, enabling direct input.
* Fixed battle gimmick permissions following the wrong Pokémon after switching.
* Fixed battle AI using outdated abilities after Skill Swap or Simple Beam.
* Fixed battle AI retaining temporary abilities after Transform.
##### Changed
###### Badges & Presentations
* Changed default badge layouts to center badges, names, and descriptions.
* Changed automatic acquisition notices to remain visible for at least eight seconds.
* Changed badge Play and Pause controls to Unicode icons with localized narration.
* Changed presentation effect properties into inline Transform and Effect inspector tabs.
###### NPC Behavior & Post-Battle Actions
* Changed DNPC trainer behavior to allow dashing and returning even with position locking enabled.
* Changed Sequential mode to pause remaining actions after dialogue cancellation or player disconnection.
###### Pokémon Settings
* Changed Pokémon settings into Basic, Stats, Moves, and Appearance tabs.
##### Improved
###### Badge & Presentation Editors
* Improved badge grid readability with centered names.
* Improved badge grid separation, inspector sections, and compact playback button layouts.
* Improved badge editor tabs, selectors, picker states, preset names, and mode-specific properties.
###### RCT Trainer Discovery
* Improved RCT trainer discovery with support for up to 4,096 entries.
###### Pokémon Inspector
* Improved nature, ability, move, and gimmick summaries in the Pokémon inspector.
###### Battle AI
* Improved battle AI support for Helping Hand and Dragon Cheer.
* Improved AI support for Skill Swap, Simple Beam, and Psych Up.
* Improved Z-Move decisions with accuracy, recharge, and resource conservation.
#### NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Fixed
* Fixed Pokémon send-out settings being lost when loading and saving Fabric trainer profiles.
* Fixed badge thumbnails disappearing behind collection card backgrounds.
* Fixed NPCs failing to return after trainer dialogue was canceled.
#### Fabric 1.21.1
##### Fixed
* Fixed automatic encounters skipping mapped pre-battle dialogues and their Go Battle actions.
* Fixed badge thumbnails disappearing behind collection card backgrounds.
* Fixed Nurse Joy server JSON profiles not being loaded when applied.
